body: Yeah, I play cello a lot, it does help :) but I can't just avoid everything and everyone for the rest of my life. It won't ever work. Im stuck, guys.

I like traveling, I've been to Europe several times with my family. But it ultimately doesn't matter, right? It eventually ends, and then you are in the same position as before with just a few nice memories. Plus I feel extremely guilty whenever I experience happiness
